unit: per 1M tokens, paid tier, text input / text output (output includes thinking tokens)

sources.pricing: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing  (page states: 'Last updated 2026-10-22 UTC'; read 2026-10-23 via WebFetch, two independent fetches agreed)
sources.batch: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/batch-api  (Batch = 50% of the standard interactive price; target turnaround 24h; job expires after 48h; results kept 6 weeks; inline requests < 20 MB; input file max 2 GB)
sources.rate_limits: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits  (batch: 100 concurrent batch requests, 2 GB input file, 20 GB file storage, enqueued-token cap per model and tier)
sources.thinking: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thinking  (today's page documents control via thinking_level in generation_config; it does NOT mention thinkingBudget, so the budget semantics below are UNVERIFIED)
sources.deprecations: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations  (2.5 Pro/Flash/Flash-Lite: GA, no shutdown date, 'access limited to users who have actively used them in the past' -> a NEW key may not get 2.5 models)
sources.terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms  (paid services: prompts/responses not used to improve products; prohibits using the Services to develop competing models; says nothing on benchmark references or SynthID)

notes: Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash and Gemini 4 Argon have introductory prices that rise on a fixed date (see *_later fields); the cost script uses the CURRENT price by default, --phase later uses the later price.
Gemini 2.5 Pro and 3.1 Pro have a >200k-token prompt tier; every request here is far below 200k, so only the <=200k price is used.

Prices for 3.1 Flash-Lite: the pricing page lists it, but the thinking page does not list a plain gemini-3.1-flash-lite entry, so its availability for Batch text translation was not independently verified.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
gemini-2.5-flash-lite.thinking_note: Off by default on the thinking page; so default == off.

gemini-2.5-flash.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
gemini-2.5-flash.thinking_note: Thinking ON by default (dynamic). Disabling (budget 0 in the 2.5 API) is from memory of the 2.5 docs: UNVERIFIED on today's page, which documents only thinking_level.

gemini-2.5-pro.label: Gemini 2.5 Pro
gemini-2.5-pro.thinking_note: Thinking ON, cannot be switched off (from memory of 2.5 docs, UNVERIFIED today; the thinking page lists levels low/medium/high only).

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
gemini-3.1-flash-lite.thinking_note: Not on the thinking page table (unverified); assumed minimal/off like 3.5 Flash-Lite.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.thinking_note: Default thinking_level = minimal (thinking page); 'minimal' is not stated to be exactly zero thinking, so default is modelled as +200 hidden tokens.

gemini-3.6-flash.label: Gemini 3.6 Flash
gemini-3.6-flash.thinking_note: Default thinking_level medium; supports minimal..high (thinking page).

gemini-3.8-flash.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini-3.8-flash.thinking_note: Default thinking_level medium; lowest listed level is 'low' (no 'minimal'), so thinking cannot be fully switched off: the 'off' row is omitted.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview)
gemini-3.1-pro-preview.thinking_note: Default high; levels low/medium/high; cannot be off.

gemini-4-argon.label: Gemini 4 Argon
gemini-4-argon.thinking_note: Default medium; levels low/medium/high; cannot be off.
